product_family: Machine translation software family: free web translator (SYSTRAN Translate), paid Pro tier, Enterprise/API translation platform, on-premise/air-gapped Server deployment, Model Studio for custom model training, and Anonymizer for GDPR-oriented PII redaction. Owned by French data-processing group ChapsVision (acquired SYSTRAN S.A. in January 2024).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Certified for compliance: ISO 27001 | GDPR Compliant | HIPAA Ready

certifications.name: ISO 27001 (corroborating)
certifications.proof_quote: Our facilities, teams, policies, and procedures have been audited to guarantee strict adherence to prominent security standards.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I/II)
certifications.proof_quote: FAQ: 'We already have SOC 2 Type II vendors. Isn't that enough?' Answer: 'SOC 2 is a baseline, not a ceiling. Many generic AI tools hold SOC 2 but still operate on multi-tenant public clouds...' -- SYSTRAN's own FAQ frames SOC 2 as something competitors/other vendors hold, and does not claim SOC 2 for SYSTRAN itself anywhere on the vendor domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Listed only as 'HIPAA Ready' (not 'HIPAA certified' or 'HIPAA compliant'). No BAA (Business Associate Agreement) language or independent HIPAA certification evidence found on the vendor domain. HIPAA has no official third-party certification body, so 'Ready' is a self-declared design posture, not a certification.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: Data-sovereignty page lists "GDPR Compliant" as part of "Certified for compliance: ISO 27001 | GDPR Compliant | HIPAA Ready". The privacy-policy URL resolves to a ChapsVision legal notice stating only "Chapsvision is committed to complying with applicable regulations regarding personal data protection" and links out to a separate ChapsVision Data Protection Policy. No SYSTRAN-domain page contains a standalone sentence asserting GDPR and French-law compliance verbatim, so GDPR posture rests on the 'GDPR Compliant' marketing badge rather than a detailed policy statement.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence -- not mentioned on the security page, data sovereignty page, or privacy policy.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence -- not mentioned on any vendor-domain page reviewed.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor domain. Third-party marketing aggregator sites reference 'DoD-ready,' but this is not corroborated by a vendor-domain page.

privacy.ai_training_note: Marketing headline states 'zero data retention' and that customer data is 'never used to train our base models.' The Enterprise Terms of Service corroborate this for general model training and confirm Content/Final Content is deleted once the service is complete (with a 72-hour exception for automated error-pattern QA). However, the same ToS state 'Linguistic Data are stored on the Platform for an indefinite period of time,' and permit SYSTRAN to reuse Customer Content only to customize a customer's own dedicated Model at that customer's request, a narrower, opt-in exception, not general base-model training. The 'zero data retention' marketing line should be read alongside this Terms of Service nuance rather than as an unqualified blanket claim.
privacy.data_region: Configurable by deployment: air-gapped on-premise, private cloud, or 'sovereign SaaS' positioned to match customer compliance/region requirements. Company headquartered in Paris, France (EU). No single fixed default data region is stated on the pages reviewed.

security.value: Regular penetration tests conducted during major and minor releases.

security.name: Infrastructure hardening
security.value: Partitioned cloud infrastructure, firewalls, and IP-based access restrictions.

security.name: Secure development practices
security.value: States alignment with OWASP cybersecurity best practices.

security.name: Deployment isolation options
security.value: Air-gapped on-premise, private cloud, or sovereign SaaS deployment, allowing data to stay entirely within the customer's security perimeter.

security.name: File retention controls
security.value: For file translations (e.g. PDFs), automatic deletion after a configurable period; Content/Final Content deleted once the Enterprise service completes, with a 72-hour exception for error-pattern QA.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Not explicitly documented on vendor pages reviewed; only infrastructure-level protections (partitioned cloud, firewalls) are described. Not confirmed either way.

products.name: SYSTRAN Translate (free web translator)
products.notes: Privacy policy explicitly instructs users not to submit personal data via the online tools; SYSTRAN disclaims liability for GDPR issues arising from user-submitted personal data on this tier.

products.name: SYSTRAN Translate Pro
products.notes: Paid tier with its own Terms of Service page; not separately verified beyond the general privacy/security posture.

products.name: SYSTRAN Translate Enterprise / API
products.data_scope: Enterprise content, documents, and 'Linguistic Data' (glossaries/translation memory)
products.notes: Marketing claims zero data retention and zero base-model training; ToS confirms Content deletion post-service (72-hour QA exception), but 'Linguistic Data' is retained indefinitely on the platform.

products.name: SYSTRAN Translate Server (on-premise / air-gapped)
products.data_scope: Fully within customer's own infrastructure; can run with zero internet connection
products.notes: Positioned for legal, life sciences, and defense/government customers requiring maximum data confidentiality.

products.name: SYSTRAN Model Studio
products.data_scope: Customer-provided glossaries/translation memory used to fine-tune the customer's own private model
products.notes: ToS explicitly limits SYSTRAN's reuse of customer content to customizing that customer's own dedicated model, not SYSTRAN's general base models.

products.name: SYSTRAN Anonymizer
products.data_scope: Detects and redacts personal data within translated text
products.notes: Marketed as a compliance aid for customers handling sensitive/personal data through translation workflows.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered: free web translator, paid Pro subscription, Enterprise with fixed annual pricing for translation volume, plus on-premise Server licensing.
compare.data_residency: Configurable via air-gapped on-premise, private cloud, or sovereign SaaS; HQ in Paris, France (EU). No single fixed default region for the free/Pro cloud tiers.

flags: SOC 2 is not held by SYSTRAN; the vendor's own FAQ frames SOC 2 as something other vendors/prospects already have and states it is 'a baseline, not a ceiling,' confirming SYSTRAN does not claim it.

'HIPAA Ready' is a self-declared marketing phrase bundled visually with the genuine ISO 27001 certification under a 'Certified for compliance' banner, which risks implying HIPAA is a certification on par with ISO 27001. It is shown separately with a caveat.

Top-of-page marketing promises 'zero data retention,' but the Enterprise Terms of Service state 'Linguistic Data are stored on the Platform for an indefinite period of time' and allow a 72-hour retention window for QA.

The ISO 27001 claim is corroborated on two vendor-domain pages but has not been independently verified against a public ISO certification registry or certificate number; it is vendor-attested pending a certificate or scope document.

Parent company is ChapsVision (acquired SYSTRAN S.A. in Jan 2024); the corporate legal notice and privacy policy route partly through chapsvision.com. This is the genuine SYSTRAN (machine translation, founded 1968, HQ Paris), not a different, similarly named entity.
